reviewNotes: HOLD — the university officially lists a Faculty of Medicine, while Djibouti legal sources establish the national Doctor of Medicine framework and the Faculty's statutory oversight. The current accessible sources do not provide a current programme duration/language, tuition and mandatory costs, international eligibility, cycle dates, clinical placements, housing/support or programme-recognition record. No fee or foreign-admission claim has been inferred from the legal framework. No second safe university-level medical candidate was identified; ISSS is a separate health-sciences institute rather than a university.
